editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing you are trapped in a nightmare where the person supposed to take care of you is actually your worst enemy. You follow a young guy who gets snatched up and held captive by a nurse who is completely out of her mind. The vibe is super creepy and tense because you spend most of the time feeling stuck right there with him. It is a small-scale story, but the feeling of helplessness makes it feel way bigger and scarier than your average slasher flick.

What really works here is how the nurse plays mind games with her victim, making you wonder if he will ever get out. The acting is solid and the pacing keeps you on edge, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action. If you love movies about crazy kidnappers, you should definitely check this one out. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the end, the young man fights back against the nurse in a desperate struggle for his life. After a lot of tension and fear, he finally manages to overpower her and escape the house. He survives the ordeal, but the trauma of being held captive stays with him. It wraps up as a victory for the hero, though the experience leaves him scarred and changed by the nurse's cruelty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and scary stories about captives.
